content:
marta: Quick heads-up — docs staging deploy window is 18:00 PT today. We need SDK docs regen PRs + changelog/version bump before cutoff. Who can own smoke tests after deploy?

devon: I can run the smoke tests, but need the SDK snippets regenerated and the pkg version updated by 17:15 PT.

liam: I pushed a draft regen branch for python/js snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-sdks/pull/482 please review. Still waiting on CI artifacts.

sophia: I'm taking the changelog bump. Which version are we targeting? Patch or minor?

marta: Target is minor bump for console + SDKs — new feature toggle for routing rules. So bump to 0.13.0 across SDKs. Add short changelog entry under "Unreleased -> 0.13.0".

devon: Noted. I'll update package.json and pyproject.toml snippets. Will add a one-liner to changelog: "console: routing rules feature toggle + docs"

liam: CI is flaky for one snippet generator job — build-bot reported transient network error. If it's still failing I'll re-run after bump.

build-bot: deploy-check: staging cluster healthy, disk utilization 42%, ready for docs deploy window.

sophia: Changelog entry done and PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/1109 — tagged marta/devon for review.

marta: thanks. devon — once SDK regen PR merges, can you ensure the docs site picks the new artifacts (we point to npm tarball + sdist)?

devon: Yep. After merge I'll publish test packages to the staging npm registry and update docs config to use the staging tarball path. Command I'll run:

```
# publish to staging
npm publish --registry https://npm-staging.redwood-inference.internal
# update docs config
sed -i 's/0.12.3/0.13.0/g' docs/_config/snippets.yml
```

liam: I'll queue smoke tests at 18:10 PT — plan: a quick CLI generation -> load sample convo -> verify snippet outputs. Should take ~8-10m.

marta: If smoke fails, fallback plan is to revert docs config to 0.12.3 and re-open a hotfix PR. Call out any regressions in #eng-oncall.

sophia: Also adding a short note in the release checklist about API surface docs that changed (routing policy fields).

devon: One ask — if you touch code examples, please keep the typed examples for TypeScript unchanged (we rely on native types for snippets). I'll patch if type changes needed.

liam: Quick question — do we want to run the embed generation CI job? It takes ~20m and might push past our window.

marta: Skip heavy embed job for staging. We'll run full embed CI on canary tomorrow morning. For tonight keep to snippet gen + smoke.

build-bot: deploy-scheduler: docs deploy job queued for 2026-03-01T18:00:00-08:00 (PT). Will post status here at start/finish.

devon: I'll ping again at 17:00 PT to confirm sdk PRs merged and artifacts published.

sophia: all done on changelog + release note draft. Leaving final approvals to marta. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks team. If anything blocks, @devon or @liam call it out here and we'll decide to delay. Otherwise we proceed with the 18:00 PT window.

liam: ack — will report smoke results in this thread.

marta: (also) reminder to add the version bump line to the console release notes doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-console-release-notes — small copy nudge.
